No Foaming Action
Agent:
“I'm sorry to hear that you're not getting the foaming action you expected. Let me walk you through a few quick steps to help activate the product properly.”
Step 1 – Reduce Excess Water
“First, please give the toilet a flush to clear out some of the standing water in the bowl. Too much water can dilute the formula and prevent it from foaming properly.”
Step 2 – Use One Full Packet
“Next, please make sure you're using one full packet for each application. Using only part of a packet may result in weak or little to no fizzing.”
Step 3 – Allow Time to Activate
“Once you've sprinkled the full packet into the toilet bowl, please leave it undisturbed for about 5 to 10 minutes. This gives the formula enough time to fully activate and work.”
Step 4 – Warm Water Boost
“If you'd like to give it an extra boost, you can follow it with warm, not boiling, water. This may help the reaction along, especially if the environment is cooler.”
Agent – Closing:

“Once you've completed those steps, you should be able to see more foaming action from the cleaner. Please let me know how it goes, and we'll be happy to assist further if you're still experiencing an issue.”

Product Clumping

Agent:
“I understand your concern about the powder being clumped together. No worries — let me explain why this can happen and what you can do.”

Step 1 – Reassure the Customer
“The good news is that clumping does not affect the cleaning power of the product. The formula and ingredients remain the same, so it will work the same whether the powder is loose or slightly clumped.”


Step 2 – Break Up the Clumps
“You can simply give the packet a gentle shake or tap to loosen the powder. Once it comes into contact with water, it will activate and foam as intended.”


Step 3 – Proper Storage
“To help prevent the powder from clumping again, we recommend keeping the unused packets sealed tightly and stored in a cool, dry place. Exposure to humidity during transit or storage can sometimes cause the powder to clump.”


Agent – Closing:
“So, the clumping is mainly a cosmetic change in the powder's texture and does not indicate a product quality issue. You can still expect the same cleaning results from the product.”
Residue Left Behind
Agent:
“I understand your concern about some powder being left behind after using theToilet Cleaner. Let me walk you through a few steps that can help ensure a clean finish.”
Step 1 – Use One Full Packet

“First, please make sure you're using one full packet per application. Using more than one packet at a time can leave some powder undissolved. One packet is the recommended amount for a full cleaning.”
Step 2 – Rinse After the Foam Works

“After sprinkling the powder into the bowl, allow the foam to work for about 5 to 10 minutes. Once the wait time is complete, you can flush the toilet twice or rinse with warm, not hot, water. This helps dissolve any remaining powder and wash it away.”
Step 3 – Light Scrub if Needed
“If you still notice a small amount of residue after flushing, you can use a toilet brush or sponge for a quick, light scrub, followed by a final rinse.”
Scent Concern:
1. No bleach, no ammonia, no harsh chemicals:
the formula is made entirely from non-toxic, biodegradable, septic-safe ingredients. The scent is an Ocean Fresh fragrance added for a clean finish, not a byproduct of chemical cleaning agents.
2. Ventilate during use:
opening a window, running an exhaust fan, or leaving the bathroom door open before and during application makes a big difference in managing the fragrance strength.
3. Scent is strongest during activation:

the fragrance intensity peaks when the foam first activates and fades significantly after flushing.

The cleaning power of the product is not affected by ventilation, and the formula is safe around pets and family regardless of how strong the scent may seem during activation.
Stains Not Removed
Agent:

“I understand that you're still seeing some stubborn or older stains after using the Toilet Cleaner. Older buildup can sometimes take a little more time and more than one treatment to fully break down. Let me walk you through what you can try.”
Step 1 – Extend the Sit Time
“For older or stubborn stains, you can let the foam sit for up to 30 minutes. This gives the formula more time to work on the buildup.”
Step 2 – Reapply if Needed

“If the stain is still visible after the first treatment, you can repeat the process once or twice more over the next few days. Some older stains may require multiple treatments before you see the full results.”
Step 3 – Light Scrub After Soaking
“After allowing the product to sit, use a soft-bristled toilet brush or sponge to gently scrub the area. This can help lift the buildup that the foam has already loosened.”
Clogged Toilet
Agent:
“I understand your concern about the toilet draining slowly after using the product. Let me walk you through a few steps that may help clear any remaining product or buildup.”
Step 1 – Use One Full Packet Only
“First, please make sure you're using only one full packet per application. Using more than one packet at a time can create thicker buildup that may take longer to dissolve.”
Step 2 – Flush With Warm Water

“After allowing the foam to work for the recommended sit time, flush the toilet or rinse with warm, not boiling, water. The warm water can help break down any thick or slow-moving remnants and help clear them away.”
Step 3 – Avoid Mixing Products
“Also, please avoid mixing X-All Toilet Cleaner with bleach or other cleaning products. Mixing cleaners can cause unwanted reactions or clumping, which may affect how easily the product clears.”
Step 4 – Check for Existing Buildup

“If the toilet was already draining slowly before using the product, there may have been existing buildup or a partial blockage restricting the flow. In that case, the foam may have loosened some of that buildup, which could temporarily affect drainage.”

Skin Irritation 

Agent:

“I completely understand your concern about handling the powder. Let me share a few simple precautions to make using the product more comfortable and help minimize direct contact.”

Step 1 – Wear Gloves

“We recommend wearing rubber cleaning gloves when opening and applying the product. This provides an extra layer of protection, especially if you have sensitive skin.”

Step 2 – Avoid Direct Contact
“When opening the packet, try to sprinkle the powder directly into the toilet bowl without touching it with your hands.”

Step 3 – If Skin Contact Occurs

“If the powder accidentally gets on your skin, rinse the affected area immediately with cool water and mild soap.”

Step 4 – Use in a Well-Ventilated Area

“It's also best to use the product in a well-ventilated area with good airflow. This helps minimize exposure to any fine powder that may become airborne during application.”

Sheet1: The X-All Power Scrubber is a cordless, handheld cleaning tool designed to make everyday cleaning easier, faster, and more accessible. Its ergonomic design, multiple brush heads, and waterproof construction allow users to tackle dirt, grime, and hard-to-reach areas with minimal effort.

How to Use the X-All Power Scrubber
1. Charge the Scrubber

Before using the X-All Power Scrubber for the first time, make sure it is adequately charged. Disconnect the charger before using the device.

2. Choose the Right Brush Head

Select the brush head that best matches the surface you want to clean. Use the appropriate head for corners, edges, or smooth surfaces.

3. Attach the Brush Head

Securely attach the selected brush head to the scrubber before turning the device on. Make sure it is firmly in place.

4. Prepare the Surface

Apply your preferred cleaning solution to the surface as needed. For best results, allow the cleaner to sit briefly on stubborn dirt or grime.

5. Turn On the Scrubber

Press the power button to start the scrubber. Hold the handle securely using the no-slip grip.

6. Start Cleaning

Move the scrubber slowly across the surface using light, controlled pressure. Let the rotating brush do most of the work rather than pressing down heavily.

7. Clean Hard-to-Reach Areas

Use the appropriate brush head to reach corners, edges, and other areas that are difficult to clean manually.

8. Turn Off and Clean the Device

When finished, turn off the scrubber. Remove the brush head and rinse or clean it according to the type of brush and cleaning solution used. Wipe the main unit clean and allow removable parts to dry before storing.

Important Usage Tips
Do not immerse the entire device in water. The product is IPX5 waterproof, but waterproof does not mean submersible.
Avoid using excessive pressure while scrubbing.
Choose a brush head appropriate for the surface to help prevent scratching or damage.
Keep the charging port and charging components dry before charging.
Turn the device off before changing or removing brush heads.
Store the scrubber in a clean, dry place when not in use.

X-All Power Scrubber — Less Scrubbing, More Cleaning.
